latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI-powered TikTok video creation in seconds:

- Upload clips or images (MP4, MOV, JPG, PNG, up to 500MB); get 1080p MP4 TikTok-ready exports in under a minute.
- No manual editing; just give instructions like "turn my clips into a vertical TikTok video with music and captions."
- Automatic cloud setup: free credits, session handling, and backend communications managed for you.
- Supports credits checking, draft previews, and error handling for file size, type, and rate limits.
- Designed for creators who want to make TikTok videos fast, directly from chat.
